transcript: The way you drink water could be silently destroying your body and you don't even realize it. People think it's just water. But my teacher, Dr. Li Zhongshang, who lived to 102, warned me, water can heal you or weaken you. It depends on how you drink it. Mistake number one, ice cold water. It shocks the stomach, slows digestion and forces your body to fight instead of heal. Warm water protects your internal fire. Mistake number two, drinking too fast. When you gulp, your body cannot absorb it properly. Sip slowly, let it nourish you. Mistake number three, drinking during meals. Too much water while eating weakens digestion and creates heaviness. Mistake number four, no water before sleep. One small cup at night helps your body cleanse and repair. Mistake number five, no balance. Too little dries the organs. Too much burdens the kidneys. Wisdom is balance. Water is life. But taken the wrong way, it can slowly drain it. If this surprised you, comment yes below. Follow me for ancient health wisdom before it's forgotten.
